prompt: Generate a CLAUDE.md for this project and its three submodules, pointing each submodule back to the root

assertions.text: Managed content wrapped in `<!-- wiki-managed: start -->` and `<!-- wiki-managed: end -->` markers
Root file lists every discovered submodule with a relative link
Each submodule file includes a Parent Project link back to the root CLAUDE.md
Content outside the managed markers is preserved byte-for-byte on re-generation
